definition_en: A point in a process that slows down the whole system.
example_en: Approval from legal became the biggest bottleneck in the project.
example_uz: Yuridik bo'limdan tasdiq olish loyihadagi eng katta tirbandlik nuqtasiga aylandi.

definition_en: To generate ideas freely in a group without judging them.
example_en: The team brainstormed names for the new product for an hour.
example_uz: Jamoa yangi mahsulot uchun nomlarni bir soat davomida fikr yurishtirdi.

definition_en: The point at which costs equal income and there is no profit or loss.
example_en: The café expects to reach breakeven within its first year.
example_uz: Kafe birinchi yil ichida tanga-tanga chiqish nuqtasiga yetishni kutmoqda.

definition_en: Property offered as security for repaying a loan.
example_en: The bank required the building as collateral for the loan.
example_uz: Bank kredit uchun binoni garov mulk sifatida talab qildi.

definition_en: A large company made up of several smaller, different businesses.
example_en: The airline is now part of a global travel conglomerate.
example_uz: Aviakompaniya endi global sayohat konglomeratining bir qismi.

definition_en: To give a task or responsibility to someone else.
example_en: A good manager delegates instead of doing everything herself.
example_uz: Yaxshi menejer hamma narsani o'zi qilish o'rniga vakolat beradi.

definition_en: A specific output that a project promises to produce.
example_en: The first deliverable is a working prototype by March.
example_uz: Birinchi topshiriladigan natija — mart oyiga qadar ishlaydigan namuna.

definition_en: To expand a business into new areas to reduce risk.
example_en: The firm diversified into software after steel prices fell.
example_uz: Po'lat narxlari tushgach, firma dasturiy ta'minotga xilma-xillashtirdi.

definition_en: To reduce the number of employees, usually to cut costs.
example_en: The company downsized after losing its biggest client.
example_uz: Kompaniya eng katta mijozini yo'qotgach xodimlar sonini qisqartirdi.

definition_en: A person or firm hired to find candidates for senior jobs.
example_en: A headhunter approached her about the CEO role.
example_uz: Kadrlar izlovchi u bilan bosh direktor lavozimi haqida bog'landi.

definition_en: Unable to pay debts owed.
example_en: The retailer was declared insolvent after months of losses.
example_uz: Chakana savdo kompaniyasi bir necha oylik zarardan so'ng to'lovga qodir emas deb e'lon qilindi.

definition_en: To communicate and cooperate regularly with another group.
example_en: She liaises between the design team and the client.
example_uz: U dizayn jamoasi va mijoz o'rtasida aloqa o'rnatib turadi.

definition_en: Building professional relationships that may be useful later.
example_en: He found his current job through networking at a conference.
example_uz: U hozirgi ishini konferensiyada aloqa o'rnatish orqali topdi.

definition_en: Acting in advance to prevent problems rather than reacting to them.
example_en: A proactive support team catches issues before customers notice.
example_uz: Tashabbuskor qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi mijozlar sezmasdan oldin muammolarni tutadi.

definition_en: Producing more income than costs.
example_en: The branch became profitable within its second year.
example_uz: Filial ikkinchi yilida daromadli bo'ldi.

definition_en: A document describing an investment, company or course to potential buyers.
example_en: The prospectus outlined the risks before the share sale.
example_uz: Taklifnoma hujjati aksiyalar sotuvidan oldin xatarlarni bayon qildi.

definition_en: To change a company's name or image, usually to reposition it.
example_en: The airline rebranded after the merger to unify both fleets.
example_uz: Aviakompaniya qo'shilishdan keyin ikkala flotni birlashtirish uchun brendini yangiladi.

definition_en: To move to a different place, especially for work.
example_en: The head office is relocating to a smaller building downtown.
example_uz: Bosh ofis shahar markazidagi kichikroq binoga ko'chirilmoqda.

definition_en: To reorganise a company's structure, often to cut costs.
example_en: The bank restructured its debt to avoid bankruptcy.
example_uz: Bank bankrotlikdan qochish uchun qarzini qayta tashkil etdi.

definition_en: Able to grow easily to a much larger size.
example_en: Investors liked the idea because it was scalable across countries.
example_uz: Investorlar g'oyani yoqtirishdi, chunki u turli mamlakatlarda kengaytirilishi mumkin edi.

definition_en: A person who owns shares in a company.
example_en: Shareholders approved the merger at Thursday's meeting.
example_uz: Aksiyadorlar payshanba kunidagi majlisda qo'shilishni ma'qulladi.

definition_en: Having enough money to pay all debts.
example_en: The fund remained solvent even during the downturn.
example_uz: Fond pasayish davrida ham to'lovga qodir bo'lib qoldi.

definition_en: A person or group with an interest in a business's decisions.
example_en: Every stakeholder was consulted before the policy changed.
example_uz: Siyosat o'zgarishidan oldin har bir manfaatdor tomon bilan maslahatlashildi.

definition_en: The act of gaining control of a company by buying most of its shares.
example_en: The takeover was completed without a single job lost.
example_uz: Kompaniyani sotib olish bitta ham ish o'rni yo'qotilmasdan yakunlandi.

definition_en: To put a plan, resource or system into effective use.
example_en: The new software will be deployed across all branches by June.
example_uz: Yangi dasturiy ta'minot iyungacha barcha filiallarda joriy qilinadi.

definition_en: A serious attempt to achieve something.
example_en: The joint endeavor took three companies and two years.
example_uz: Bu qo'shma harakat uch kompaniya va ikki yilni talab qildi.

definition_en: Whether a plan can realistically be carried out.
example_en: A feasibility study preceded the decision to expand abroad.
example_uz: Chet elga kengayish qaroridan oldin amalga oshirilish imkoniyati tadqiqoti o'tkazildi.

definition_en: The formal start of a project or event.
example_en: The kickoff meeting set the deadlines for every team.
example_uz: Boshlanish yig'ilishi har bir jamoa uchun muddatlarni belgiladi.

definition_en: The dismissal of employees, usually for economic reasons.
example_en: The layoffs affected nearly a tenth of the workforce.
example_uz: Ishdan bo'shatishlar ishchi kuchining deyarli o'ndan biriga ta'sir qildi.

definition_en: Relating to the detailed organisation of a complex operation.
example_en: Shipping to three continents raised serious logistical problems.
example_uz: Uch qit'aga yetkazib berish jiddiy logistikaga oid muammolarni keltirib chiqardi.

definition_en: The process of integrating a new employee into a company.
example_en: A clear onboarding plan reduced first-week questions sharply.
example_uz: Aniq ishga moslashtirish rejasi birinchi hafta savollarini keskin kamaytirdi.

definition_en: Paying an outside company to do work instead of doing it in-house.
example_en: Outsourcing payroll freed the team to focus on hiring.
example_uz: Ish haqi hisobini tashqi manbadan foydalanish jamoani yollashga e'tibor qaratishga bo'shatdi.

definition_en: A benefit given to employees in addition to their salary.
example_en: Free lunch is one of the smaller perks of the job.
example_uz: Bepul tushlik ishning kichikroq qo'shimcha imtiyozlaridan biri.

definition_en: The minimum number of people needed for a meeting's decisions to count.
example_en: Without a quorum, the board could not vote on the merger.
example_uz: Kvorum bo'lmasa, kengash qo'shilish bo'yicha ovoz bera olmasdi.

definition_en: To formally approve an agreement so it becomes valid.
example_en: The board ratified the new supplier contract on Monday.
example_uz: Kengash dushanba kuni yangi yetkazib beruvchi shartnomasini rasman tasdiqladi.

definition_en: Payment given to an employee when their job ends.
example_en: Severance packages included two months' salary.
example_uz: Ishdan bo'shatish to'lovlari ikki oylik maoshni o'z ichiga oldi.

definition_en: To state something clearly as a required condition of an agreement.
example_en: The contract stipulates a thirty-day notice period.
example_uz: Shartnoma o'ttiz kunlik ogohlantirish muddatini shart qilib qo'ygan.

definition_en: An extra fee added to the usual cost.
example_en: A fuel surcharge was added to every delivery invoice.
example_uz: Har bir yetkazib berish hisob-fakturasiga yoqilg'i uchun qo'shimcha to'lov qo'shildi.

definition_en: Extra benefit gained when two things work together rather than apart.
example_en: The merger was pitched to investors as pure synergy.
example_uz: Qo'shilish investorlarga sof o'zaro ta'sir samarasi sifatida taqdim etildi.

definition_en: To accept financial responsibility for a venture, or to insure it.
example_en: A single bank underwrote the entire bond issue.
example_uz: Bitta bank butun obligatsiya chiqarilishini kafolatlab moliyalashtirdi.
